acceptance_signal: The producer write-closure is exported by each generated GY producer via declared_outputs(), and registration is validated against that closure rather than used as discovery.
The deny-by-default output-root accounting rejects every unaccounted committed file under the GY roots, including unregistered GY output-root artifacts with no provenance marker.
Every generated GY producer output carries a GY provenance marker and every accounted GY output resolves to exactly one generated-artifacts family output.
The lifecycle gate rejects missing registered outputs, duplicate family claims, and stale_output_behavior drift without adding per-family discovery code.
Public/API/dashboard exposure is either absent by contract or consumes may_not_use_for/candidate_only/not_publishable semantics from the authoritative GY runtime state.
